stem.en: A strip of air particles sits above a graph of density against distance. The dashed line shows the average density. Which point on the graph shows a compression?

text.en: A crest, the highest point of the curve.
A trough, the lowest point of the curve.
A point where the curve crosses the dashed line.
Any point on the dashed line.

explanation.en: A compression is a region where the density is higher than average, so it is shown by a crest, above the dashed line. A trough shows a rarefaction. Where the curve crosses the dashed line, the density is exactly average.

hints.en: Is the density in a compression higher or lower than average?
Higher than average means above the dashed line.
